PhotoMind / 拾光相册 — Android 隐私政策 更新日期 / Updated: 2026-10-08 开发者：张祥（Xiang Zhang） 联系邮箱：zhangxiang_0318@126.com 简体中文 PhotoMind 无需注册账号。照片、视频、搜索词、文字识别与画面搜索索引在本机处理。应用不包含广告和开发者运营的分析服务，也没有照片上传功能。Android 应用本身不申请互联网访问权限。 经你授权，应用通过 Android MediaStore 读取你允许访问的本机照片、视频，以及拍摄日期、名称、文件大小、尺寸、时长、收藏状态等信息。Android 14 及以上可只授权选中的内容。Android 10 起也可以通过系统照片选择器选择特定照片和视频，无需授权整个图库；应用仅保留你选择内容的读取授权，不复制原件。你可以在设置中忘记这些已选内容，其对应访问授权和本机索引会移除。选择器提供的内容只读，删除原件请使用系统相册。系统选择器及其内容提供方可能按你的选择读取云端文件，其联网行为由该提供方管理。你可随时在系统设置中修改访问范围；重新核对权限后，无权访问内容的索引会被删除。云端相册中尚未下载、且 MediaStore 不提供的内容不会被当作已处理。 识别出的文字、图像向量、视频抽样画面特征、你添加的标签与保留决定保存在应用私有存储。人物匹配使用本机人脸检测与 SFace 特征模型；只有你手动确认的人脸才成为参考样本。姓名、称呼、特征和纠错决定不会上传，不保存独立的人脸裁剪图片。人物匹配用于个人相册整理，可能出错，不用于身份验证。你可在人物管理中删除标记。 只有在你使用地点命名时，应用才请求读取媒体已有位置元数据的权限。地点名称与坐标只在本机用于附近约 80 米的媒体匹配；不会请求设备实时位置，也不执行在线逆地理编码。 本机搜索索引、人脸特征、标签和地点排除云备份与设备迁移。清除应用数据或卸载会移除这些本机数据；原照片、视频和你主动保存的导出副本不受影响。重新准备索引会保留标签、人物名称与手动确认、命名地点和保留决定。 缩略图缓存在内存中。导出会在应用缓存目录产生临时文件；超过 24 小时的临时文件在下次启动时清理。你选择保存的副本会成为相册中的新文件，原片保持不变。删除需由你确认，并遵循 Android 与相册提供方的规则；云同步、恢复和空间释放由相册提供方管理。 文字识别和人脸模型随安装包提供。场景搜索模型在首次打开时通过 Google Play 按当前语言下载，校验通过后在本机使用；切换语言可能需要下载另一套模型。下载需要网络，完成后可离线使用；清除应用数据或卸载后可能需要重新下载。Google Play 管理网络等待、传输和更新。Google Play、Android、你选择的分享目标与邮箱服务由各自服务提供方管理，遵循各自隐私政策。点击系统分享后，选中的媒体会交给你选择的接收应用。请只在需要时向支持邮箱发送照片或其他个人信息。 应用使用 Google ML Kit 的随包文字识别和人脸检测组件。Google 的 SDK 说明列有设备型号、系统与应用版本、每次安装的标识符、处理耗时、配置、输入输出大小和错误等诊断与使用指标。它不要求上传你处理的照片、文字内容或人脸特征。本应用移除了直接联网权限；这不等于我们能控制 Android 或 Google Play 服务的全部行为。请参阅 https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/android-data-disclosure 和 https://policies.google.com/privacy 了解 Google 的处理规则。 English PhotoMind requires no account. Photo and video analysis, text recognition, visual search and search queries are processed on your device. The app contains no advertising or developer-operated analytics and has no photo upload feature. The Android app does not request the Internet permission. With your permission, PhotoMind reads locally accessible media and metadata through Android MediaStore: capture dates, names, file sizes, dimensions, durations and favorites. Android 14 and later support access to selected items. On Android 10 and later, you can also choose specific photos and videos through the system picker without granting whole-library access. The app retains read permission for the items you select without copying originals. Settings can forget these selected items and remove their access grants and local index. Picker items are read-only; use the system gallery to delete originals. The system picker or its content provider may retrieve cloud files you select; its network behavior is managed by that provider. You can change access in system settings. After reconciliation, the index for media no longer accessible is removed. Cloud-only content unavailable through MediaStore is not reported as processed. Recognized text, visual embeddings, sampled video analysis, labels and keep decisions are stored privately on this device. People matching uses local face detection and SFace features. Only manually confirmed faces become reference samples. Names, aliases, features and corrections are not uploaded, and separate face crops are not saved. Matching may be incorrect and is for personal library organization, not authentication. People labels can be removed in people management. When you name a place, PhotoMind requests access only to location metadata already stored in media. Names and coordinates remain local and match media within approximately 80 metres. The app does not request live device location or use online reverse geocoding. The local index, face features, labels and places are excluded from cloud backup and device transfer. Clearing app data or uninstalling removes local app data without deleting original media or saved exports. Rebuilding the index preserves labels, named people, manually confirmed faces, named places and keep decisions. Thumbnails are cached in memory. Exports create temporary app-cache files; files older than 24 hours are removed on the next launch. Saved copies become new gallery items and leave originals unchanged. Deletion requires confirmation and follows Android and your gallery provider’s rules. Cloud synchronization, recovery and storage reclamation are controlled by the gallery provider. Text-recognition and face models are bundled. Visual-search models are downloaded by Google Play for the current language when the app first opens and are used locally after validation. Changing languages may require another model download. Downloading requires a network connection; completed models work offline. Clearing app data or uninstalling may require downloading them again. Google Play manages transfer, network waiting and updates. Google Play, Android, sharing destinations and email providers are separate services governed by their own policies. When you share, selected media is passed to your chosen receiving app. Send personal information to support only when needed to resolve your request. PhotoMind uses Google ML Kit's bundled text recognition and face detection components. Google's SDK disclosure lists device, OS and application information, per-installation identifiers, processing latency, configuration, input/output sizes and error events used for diagnostics and usage analytics. This does not require uploading the contents of your photos, recognized text or face embeddings. This app removes direct Internet permission; this does not give us control over every behavior of Android or Google Play services. See https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/android-data-disclosure and https://policies.google.com/privacy for Google's processing rules.
